Class ResearchService

java.lang.Object
university_system.ResearchService
public class ResearchService extends Object
Service class responsible for managing research-related operations. This class works with research profiles, research projects, project members and research papers.

      public void createResearchProfile(User user)
      Assigns a research profile to a user. A research profile is represented by a Researcher object.
      Parameters:
      user - the user who becomes a researcher
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if user is null
      IllegalStateException - if the user already has a research profile
